name: Umbral Tamiz
motion: Side-hung door pair inside a gridded screen: lever down, the first leaf swings to 92°, the second follows to 90°, then they close (Doors_Open); the lever hotspot opens only the first leaf to ~72° (Leaf_Active_Open).
options: Size (3 variants: door pair 1.4 / 1.7 / 2.0 m with sidelights and transom)
Steel: Acero Grafito, Negro Carbón, Bronce Umbra, Piedra, Anodizado Natural
Handle: Latón Cepillado, Bronce Umbra, Anodizado Natural, Negro Carbón
Glazing bars: grid, horizontal bands, no bars
Glass: Claro, Bronce tinted, Satinado acid-etched, Acanalado reeded
Lever: round rose, long plate, square rose

hotspots.title: Open both doors
hotspots.text: The first leaf swings to 92°, the second follows to 90°. Then they close in the same order, reversed.

hotspots.title: Lever
hotspots.text: On a round rose, a long plate or a square rose. Press it and the first leaf opens on its own.

hotspots.title: Powder-coated steel
hotspots.text: Hot-rolled, galvanised, powder-coated to 30 % gloss. It reads matt in daylight.

hotspots.title: Glass
hotspots.text: 16.4 mm insulating glass behind 25 mm bars. Claro, Satinado, Acanalado or Bronce.

hotspots.title: Low threshold
hotspots.text: 15 mm high. The floor runs through from one room to the next.

geometry.note: max leaf from the 3.6 m size (door pair 2000 × 2400); horizontal coupling 85 mm

stills.finish: Acero Grafito steel, Latón Cepillado levers

gaps: The source context is an exterior terrace; the model still carries a stone terrace strip on one side, which reads as the next room's floor.
Only three lever shapes; no single-door or arched layouts.
Bronce glass is the source solar-control pane re-tinted in the GLB, with a drawn swatch thumbnail.
